title: Metro Manila air quality improves as Indonesia haze disperses — DENR

blocks.text: Air quality in Metro Manila has started to improve after several areas recorded “very unhealthy” levels in recent days, with the DENR saying the conditions were caused by a combination of transboundary haze from Indonesia and local pollution sources.
